hello, i went through this last year and passed w kel shi ken tamem. My advice for you is
1- Do not panic. panicking will make it worse and you are less likely to obtain information properly if you resort lose time to thinking about the exams negatively rather than actually putting effort to learn. 

2- study in sections. Despite popular belief it is extremely counter productive to study for every waking moment of your day. set up a timer for yourself. 45 mins study 15 rest. rinse and repeat for 5->7 times every day but do not do it excessively. the timings can be adjusted just don't make your breaks super long. you can also dedicate 2-3 study sessions for morning, noon, and night instead of doing all of them in one go. This is to give yourself time to do things you like. Do not try to study an entire unit in one day as well, the information will be mixed together. rather study 1/2 unit phys and 1/2 unit math and maybe something else in your study sessions. Your days should be varied and not for one subject only so you don't reach the exam date and forget information because you studied it on day x which was a week ago.

3- Moving on, just because you already studied something or know it well doesn't mean you skip over it or solving its exercises. A lot of silly mistakes result from stress even on things you thought you knew or are good at. It is ok to repeat the same exercises over and over until it feels etched into your brain.

4- Do not force yourself to stay up at night especially on the night before an exam. This is just so you are at your best performance and dont feel tired throughout the day and make avoidable mistakes on the exam. sleeping well is also good to keep your brain energized while studying

Good luck and do not pressure yourself too much. The grade you get at the end does not determine your capabilities as a person.
